messages:
sara: quick heads-up: ran an audit coverage pass across api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. uploaded a gap matrix and marking items for triage.

sara: top-level gaps: api-gateway not emitting response-mapping.headers and body-sanitization events; auth missing `role.update` and service-account lifecycle events; console missing `ui.setting.change`; billing missing `invoice.view` events for admin personas; runtime missing `model.promotion` and `fallback.switch` pointers.

mike: link to matrix?

sara: https://our-gcs/path/audit-coverage-2026-03-20.csv (added 'schema_action' column). api-gateway & runtime flagged as requiring schema extensions; billing/console mostly toggles.

alisha: for auth, we should record both intent and result. also want `request_reason` and `policy_version` when changes are policy-driven.

mike: proposed compact role.update schema snippet:

``
{"event_type":"role.update","svc":"auth","actor":"user:alice","target":"user:bob","intent":["admin"],"result":["editor"],"outcome":"partial","req_id":"r_xyz","audit_v":"v2.1"}
```

alisha: include `source_ip` and `auth_mechanism` (e.g., `sso`, `api_key`).

ankur: runtime model promotions shouldn't embed large manifests. recommend `promotion_id`, `from_model_id`, `to_model_id`, `delta_summary` (small), and artifact_url.

sara: agree, and redact any model weights or token-level thresholds. artifact_url should be internal-only.

mike: KMS: never log key material. billing: `invoice.view` must not include PII or card metadata. Use `invoice_id` and `viewer_id` only. Also want distinct `kms.key_usage` events.

alisha: security prefers `kms.key_usage` as standalone events. minimal fields: `key_id`, `op` (unwrap/encrypt), `actor`, `outcome`, `req_id`, `timestamp`.

sara: backlog priority suggestion (compliance risk -> exploitability):
- P0: auth role.update/service-account lifecycle
- P1: api-gateway response-mapping.headers/body sanitize
- P1: billing invoice.view visibility
- P2: console ui.setting.change
- P2: runtime model.promotion pointers + fallback.switch

mike: suggested owners:
- auth -> @alisha
- api-gateway -> @mike
- billing -> @sara
- console -> frontend leads (TBD)
- runtime -> @ankur

alisha: i'll take auth. rough estimate: schema + unit tests + e2e validator ~ 3 weeks.

sara: i'll own billing and get finance sign-off on sample exports.

mike: infra notes:
- bump audit schema to v2.1 for newly extended events
- deploy an ingest compatibility shim that normalizes v1->v2
- update audit-indexer to index canonical v2 fields

sara: QA ask: make a verification tool (lambda or container) that simulates customer events across services and can be run by support for customer-facing validation.

ankur: will file GH issues and attach matrix.

audit-bot: created issues:
- GH#4780 auth/role-update & service-account audit (owner: alisha)
- GH#4781 api-gateway/response-mapping events (owner: mike)
- GH#4782 billing/invoice-view auditing (owner: sara)
- GH#4783 console/ui-setting-change (owner: TBD)
- GH#4784 runtime/model-promotion-pointer (owner: ankur)

sara: action items:
1) alisha: draft v2.1 role.update schema + examples (due 2026-04-01)
2) mike: api-gateway event PR + tests (due 2026-03-28)
3) sara: billing spec + sample export for finance (due 2026-03-30)
4) ankur: create GH issues & set milestones (done)
5) infra: add ingest shim + smoke-audit job in canary (owner: mike/sysinfra) (due 2026-04-07)

mike: retention policy: keep v1 raw for 60 days post-migration then coldstore; index canonical v2 only.

alisha: we should also add an `event_sanitizer` step in pipeline to strip any accidental PII.

sara: request infra add a nightly smoke that emits one sample event per service through the full pipeline.

mike: will add `smoke-audit` job to canary and nightly.

alisha: starting schema PR now and will tag reviewers.

sara: ping me for compliance docs. closing once PRs merged & GH issues are linked.

ankur: thanks all :thumbsup:
